messages:
sara_support: Customer reports free-trial credits didn't appear after we clicked 'Approve' in the support console. They saw a spinning loader for ~30s then a toast "Action completed" but balance unchanged. Account: org-8421, user: alice@widgetco.com. Tried twice.
miguel_engineer: Can you paste the console action id or request id from the support UI? That helps trace the backoffice job.
sara_support: action id shown in UI was `SUP-20260308-8421-7`. I checked backoffice events page — the action landed but status shows `applied -> rolled_back` in the last step. No clear error message.
miguel_engineer: Rolling back sounds like a downstream failure. Did we hit a billing integration error? Any webhook failures? Can you grab the webhooks log for that timestamp? Also include the backoffice job id if available.
sara_support: Backoffice job id: `job-cc-00a9`. Webhooks show 200 from billing-service but an intermittent `500` from ledger-write at 2026-03-08T14:22:31Z. Attached console snippet:
```
POST /v1/ledger/write 500 InternalError {"error":"timeout committing tx"}
Action job job-cc-00a9: state=rolled_back, reason="downstream write failed"
```
miguel_engineer: Good repro. Looks like the support console does a two-phase: create grant record, call ledger write, then mark grant applied. If ledger write fails we trigger rollback job. That explains toast "completed" on UI (it finished the control flow) but didn't apply credits.
ops_bot: @miguel_engineer launched rollout v2.4.1 to backoffice that includes retry logic for ledger writes — deploy id deploy-788. CI: ✅ staging smoke passed.
miguel_engineer: Thanks. We need a hotfix for stuck customers who saw rolled_back. Two parts: 1) manual re-run of idempotent grant flow for job-cc-00a9, 2) fix retry/backoff and surface actionable error in UI. I'll take 2. Who can run 1? @dan_dbadmin?
dan_dbadmin: I can run a manual ledger replay for job-cc-00a9 but need confirmation this re-run won't double-credit if partial commit occurred. Does the grant record have an idempotency token?
miguel_engineer: Yes, grants use `grant_op_id` stored on the record. Replay path checks for existing ledger entries by op id and skips duplicates. Safe to replay.
ryan_support_manager: Prioritize customer-facing fix first. Sara, please offer the customer a manual apply + apology and ETA for full fix. Hold off if customer already used credits.
sara_support: Reached out to Alice at WidgetCo with offer to apply credits manually and asked if they've used them. She replied "please apply, we haven't used anything yet". She requested ETA and if there will be any service disruption.
miguel_engineer: Manual replay scheduled now. Running idempotent apply: `tools/grant-replay --job job-cc-00a9 --force`.
ops_bot: Grant replay job job-cc-00a9-replay started at 2026-03-08T14:40:12Z. Step: validating idempotency -> OK. Ledger write -> OK 201. Grant state -> applied. Notification sent to support console.
sara_support: Confirmed with customer: balance updated +30 trial credits. Customer thanked. Leaving note on ticket.
miguel_engineer: I'll push a patch to backoffice to surface explicit 'rollback reason' in UI and expand ledger write retry to 5 attempts with exponential backoff. Target patch: PR #3348, rolling to prod in next canary window.
dan_dbadmin: Postmortem note: ledger write timeout was due to a 2s GC pause on the primary node. Added a DB alert for commit latency >500ms and increased write timeout for this call to 8s.
ryan_support_manager: Solid. Please add a short FAQ blurb for support: "If console shows completed but credits missing, check backoffice job state and run grant-replay if state=rolled_back." Keep me posted when PR merges.
miguel_engineer: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/backoffice/pull/3348 — tests & canary planned.
sara_support: Closing thread and marking ticket resolved after customer confirmation. :white_check_mark:
